title: Bulk Crafting
description: Skip intermediate crafting steps, like crafting Chests directly from Logs! Check the Gallery tab for more details and recipes.
body:
📦 Bulk Crafting

Tired of crafting items step by step? Bulk Crafting simplifies recipes to save your time!

✨ Features

  • 🚀 Efficient Crafting: Skip intermediate steps for common items.
  • ✅ Lag-Friendly: Optimized for servers and singleplayer.
  • 🛠️ Easy Install: Just drag and drop into your datapacks folder.

📝 Example

Normally, to craft a Chest, you have to convert Logs into Planks first. With this datapack, you can skip that step!

You can craft Chests directly from Logs. (No need to craft Planks first!)

📢 Have an Idea?

Do you have similar ideas for other items? Want to see a specific recipe in the next version?
Join our Discord server to share your suggestions!


⚠️ Important: For more recipes like this and to see detailed visuals, please check the GALLERY tab!
